people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
translations.bsb: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
translations.kjv: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
translations.asv: Then did the cherubim lift up their wings, and the wheels were beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
